verdict.rationale: Make documents a resource-oriented REST API spanning many account entities, including connections and their access lists, data stores, audit logs, analytics, AI agents (open beta), on-prem agents and custom properties. An official MCP server can also view and modify scenarios and related entities. However, nothing in the evidence claims or demonstrates that the API matches everything the UI can do, and some endpoints are beta or Enterprise-only. Missing for 10: an explicit UI-parity claim or coverage statement, documented API endpoints for scenario building/editing, a published OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404), and independent hands-on confirmation of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The Make API follows the REST API design. Make API is organized into resource-oriented URLs
